helpers: validation_core.py (src/RimMandrake/Utils): prepare_site L1116 = remove_intruders then destroy All/Soil/unfog/unroof, second sweep, READ-BACK of roof+rock/plant/ruin things -> UNMEASURED/SITE gate (asserted cleared-DRY start; wrong for wet/fire/plant scenes unless the scene re-asserts its staged state). site_calm L547 / site_calm_restore L578 = storyteller/threats/wild spawner off through a SettingsTransaction, restored on exit. No terrain/thing restore helper exists in validation_core. northstar shared: extensions._prep_plot L123 (ProofResetRect read back 'left=0', unroof verified, destroy/Soil NOT read back), extensions._setting/_setting_in L372/391 (flip one Mod Setting, restore shipped default in finally = settings restore + OFF control). C# RM_NorthstarProofs.ProofResetRect L735 resets excavation depth in a rect -- used at START by ~30 runners (start hygiene, not post-scene restore). Other C# entry points (ProofTank/StageBasin/SetBodyFraction/Climb/Readout/LevelSurface...) stage or read state; none restores. prep_site.py builds+verifies the golden trial site and preflight_flowworks.py refuses a dirty one (P-rows) -- the asserted start for validation_v2 phases. Most runners call start_debug_game_ready (fresh disposable map) at START and never tear down: the map is left staged (restore='partial'). Hold: no runner has a --hold/teardown decision; review stagers (owner_review_stage, scenarios_map, objects_sheet, lake_floor_stage, water/river_scenes_walk) leave scenes up by purpose (owner_review), others 'unspecified'. METHOD: rows with basis=heuristic come from an AST+regex pass over each runner's scene-like functions (classify2.py beside this file); basis=read rows were read by hand. Heuristic false negatives seen in spot checks (fire_rain, tar_fire_gate start) were fixed by override; expect ~10-20% misclassification in heuristic rows. Skipped as non-scene: selftest_*, *_fake/mock, fakegame, manifest, runsheet, site_spec, settings_registry, fw_walk_common, preflight_flowworks (credited as helper), playtest_runner/extension_proof/mission_fixture_probe (launchers), gravel_stage/shovel_stage (fixture helpers), level_water/level_surface_bar/annotate_water_scenes/work_bar/driver_stamp.
